{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.62

|gr1= Mission Information

|gr2= DLC

|descr= Returns list of DLCs that are used in the mission.
{{Feature|important|The list is created from units listed in [[Mission.sqm|mission.sqm]] and does '''not''' detect units later created by scripts.}}

|s1= [[getMissionDLCs]]

|r1= [[Array]] - list of DLCs detected for the mission

|x1= <sqf>_usedDLCs = getMissionDLCs; // returns e.g ["Orange","Enoch","Expansion","Heli","Contact","Mark","Argo","Jets"]</sqf>

|seealso= [[getDLCs]] [[getObjectDLC]] [[getPersonUsedDLCs]] [[getDLCAssetsUsageByName]] [[getDLCAssetsUsage]] [[getAssetDLCInfo]]
